_doc: Worth a Closer Look (Dungeon Alive slice 4, B1): one lore fixture for each subject but maths (maths stays the sword). Stand beside one and press D: ONE question of its subject, binary (flow over gradient). A right answer gives what it has, once; a wrong one spends it all the same (resource loss is the penalty). They give information, consumables, coin and study progress, never gear (the 10-26 loot budget). 'tier' follows the domain (data/domains.json order: the Labyrinth 1 ... the Abyss 5). 'per_floor' [min, max] from 'first_floor' on, never more than 3 questions a floor. 'rooms': the special room it belongs in first; otherwise it stands in an ordinary room. 'reward' is handled in src/game_lore_fixtures.py. A fixture with 'placement': 'boss' is set only by a gate floor's own dressing (data/boss_floors.json 'lore'), never at random.

copyist_desk.subject: grammar
copyist_desk.pass: You find the copyist's slip and set it right. The ink takes, and the page is a scroll now.
copyist_desk.fail: Your correction blots across the line. The page is spoiled.

alchemist_bench.subject: science
alchemist_bench.verb: work out what happened in the retort
alchemist_bench.pass: You see what the alchemist got wrong, and finish the work properly. A potion clears in the flask.
alchemist_bench.fail: The residue fizzes, turns brown and sets solid. Whatever it was going to be, it isn't now.

surveyor_table.subject: geography
surveyor_table.pass: You read the surveyor's marks and finish what he started. The whole floor lies on the table, and now it lies in your head.
surveyor_table.fail: You guess at the marks and smudge the ink. The map is no good to anyone now.

memorial_stone.subject: history
memorial_stone.verb: read the names on the stone
memorial_stone.pass: You know these names, or the war they died in. The last line is not a name at all: it says where they hid their stores.
memorial_stone.fail: The names mean nothing to you. They stay strangers.

wayside_icon.subject: theology
wayside_icon.pass: You know whose icon this is, and what to say to it. Something eases in you.
wayside_icon.fail: The words will not come. The candle gutters and goes out.

ledger_desk.subject: economics
ledger_desk.pass: The books do not balance, and you see why: somebody skimmed. The missing coin is in a false bottom of the drawer.
ledger_desk.fail: The figures swim. Whoever cooked these books cooked them well.

trophy_board.subject: animal
trophy_board.pass: You name every trophy on the board, and the hunter's notes beside them tell you more about what hunts this floor.
trophy_board.fail: Antlers, tusks, a skull. You could not say whose.

field_kitchen.subject: cooking
field_kitchen.pass: You know what this stew wants, and give it. It is the best thing you have eaten in a long time.
field_kitchen.fail: You stir in the wrong thing at the wrong time. The pot burns black.

brazen_head.subject: ai
brazen_head.pass: It tells you three things about this floor, and you catch the one it made up. Then, sulking, it tells you something true.
brazen_head.fail: You believe every word. The head laughs, loud enough to wake the floor.

gamblers_table.subject: trivia
gamblers_table.verb: sit in on the goblins' game
gamblers_table.pass: You know the answer to the question on the last card. The pot is yours.
gamblers_table.fail: Wrong card. You leave your stake on the table.

riddle_lintel.subject: philosophy
riddle_lintel.pass: You see what the carved question is really asking. Stone grinds on stone, and a door opens beneath the owl.
riddle_lintel.fail: Your answer is clever and wrong. The owl goes on watching.

brazier_cold.subject: science
brazier_cold.pass: You build the coals the way a fire wants to be built, and the brazier roars up. The ice round it begins to run.
brazier_cold.fail: The coals smoke, sulk and die. The kindling is spent.

smoke_vent.subject: theology
smoke_vent.verb: seal the vent with a prayer
smoke_vent.pass: You speak the words over the vent, and the smoke stops as if a door had shut. Nothing more will climb out of that one.
smoke_vent.fail: Your words go up with the smoke, and the smoke goes on.
